2608.28508.title: Phoneme- and Word-Level Metrics Using Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Forced Alignment Evaluation
2608.28508.paper_summary: Forced alignment evaluation typically requires manually annotated timestamps, limiting large-scale and multilingual analysis. We introduce two corpus-level metrics based on self-supervised (SSL) speech representations for reference-free forced alignment evaluation: Phoneme-Cluster Mutual Information (PCMI) and Word Acoustic Consistency Score (WACS). PCMI measures agreement between aligned phoneme labels and clusters induced from SSL-speech representations, while WACS measures consistency of repeated word realizations using dynamic time warping similarity between word representation sequences. Using both random and systematic perturbations, we show that PCMI and WACS degrade consistently under alignment perturbations. We further analyze the metrics across multiple alignment systems on 85 languages from FLEURS, validate them against manually annotated alignments from 45 languages in DoReCo, and evaluate them on two phonologically complex low-resource languages. The metrics effectively separate high- and low-quality alignments and correlate strongly with timestamp-based alignment quality measures. Our results demonstrate that SSL-speech representations enable scalable, reference-free forced alignment evaluation. The metrics are available as an open-source Python package at https://github.com/mahesh-ak/forced-aligner-metrics.
2608.28508.paper_summary_zh: 強制對齊評估通常需要手動標註的時間戳，這限制了大規模和多語言的分析。<lb/>我們介紹了兩個基於自監督（SSL）語音表示的語料庫級指標，用於無參考的強制對齊評估：音素聚類互信息（PCMI）和單詞聲學一致性得分（WACS）。<lb/>PCMI 測量對齊的音素標籤與從 SSL 語音表示中引發的聚類之間的協議，而 WACS 測量使用動態時間扭曲相似性來評估重複單詞實現的一致性。<lb/>通過隨機和系統性擾動，我們展示了 PCMI 和 WACS 在對齊擾動下的一致降級。<lb/>我們進一步分析了這些指標在 FLEURS 的 85 種語言中跨多個對齊系統的表現，並將它們與 DoReCo 中 45 種語言的手動標註對齊進行驗證，還在兩種語音學上複雜的低資源語言上進行了評估。<lb/>這些指標有效區分高質量和低質量的對齊，並與基於時間戳的對齊質量測量強烈相關。<lb/>我們的結果表明，SSL 語音表示使可擴展的無參考強制對齊評估成為可能。<lb/>這些指標作為開源 Python 包可在 https://github.com/mahesh-ak/forced-aligner-metrics 獲得。
